title: Undergraduate Research Program (URP) 2027
about: Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory's Undergraduate Research Program runs June 7 to August 7, 2027, for current sophomores and juniors. Applications and recommendation letters are due January 15 at 11:59 pm Pacific Standard Time; applicants hear by end of March.
requirements: Current sophomores and juniors are eligible
Letters of recommendation must arrive by the deadline

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: Field "Biological sciences research" -> objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

Program "Undergraduate Research Program (URP) 2027" (current sophomores and juniors) -> objective "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
